'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male [[NPC]] professor found at the entrance way of [[Startorch Academy]] at night, talking to a group of Regretful Outcast who were once formally accepted to become students at Startorch Academy, but instead chose to become [[Outcasts]]. 

==Location==

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Regretful Outcast:''' We were once admitted students! Here, our acceptance letter! Please, let us come back to the Academy!
:'''Lonhaim:''' ...Acceptance letter? They actually kept it all this time...?
:'''TARD-E Unit:''' Identity verification complete. Their admission was valid, but their enrollment status expired long ago.
:'''TARD-E Unit:''' No matter the reason, once you abandon your studies and become Outcasts, you must face the consequences.
:'''Pleading Outcast:''' We only wanted to learn more. That was why we traded with the outside world! Isn't the Academy supposed to welcome knowledge-seekers?
:'''Lonhaim:''' You! Do you even grasp the severity of what you've done?
:'''TARD-E Unit:''' Startorch Academy has no authority over Royan affairs. All three of you will be escorted to the [[Solisylum]] for the Roya's judgment.
:'''Regretful Outcast:''' No, wait! We can still help! We can build things! We can—!
{{Dialogue End}}
